design_description: A vibrant purple-on-lilac geometric kit built around oversized diagonal bands running continuously across the torso, shoulders and sleeves. The broad purple stripes are overlaid with a dense pixelated/halftone grid texture, giving the pattern a digital, contemporary character. The lighter lilac base keeps the design bright while the darker purple diagonals create strong movement from shoulder to hem. White collar and sleeve cuffs provide a clean, high-contrast frame and help contain the otherwise highly patterned body. Branding is kept relatively restrained at chest level, with the Momuto mark on the right and the circular Yugo crest opposite. The large, colourful Pepe's Piri Piri sponsor dominates the central chest and deliberately introduces red and yellow as contrasting accent colours. Overall, it is a bold modern graphic design: diagonal structure plus digital halftone texture, with a playful purple palette and clean white finishing details.
